profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, and trades under the ticker UBER. Its website describes the Uber platform and apps as ways to earn, eat, commute, get a ride, and simplify business travel.

On autonomous driving, the company says it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber and describes them as a key part of the future of movement. It says it is partnering with industry leaders and taking a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The company's SEC filing identifier is CIK 0001543151. Its litigation exposure is concentrated in California, where 281 cases are associated with it.
